Et.bar_b_note: A's braced timber frame, overhanging cap and stone plinth read as a built homestead wall, but the flat untextured cream infill, the pale low-poly blurry boulder beside it and the flat midday light with no haze or shafts keep it short of Palworld base-building finish and Valheim atmosphere; B's blown-out white card sinks it outright.

Qk.bar_b_note: The plated amphibian's silhouette, golden gill fronds and scale against the trainer carry it, but the uniform tiled hex pattern and the back going near-black in faint end (and in all of B) read below the owner bar's real fur and plate detail.

Ln.bar_b_note: B holds a warm olive-umber back with visible markings across all four frames, but the even, generator-regular hex tiling still looks procedural next to Palworld's authored creature surfaces, and no travel-role frame is shown.

Fa.bar_b_note: B's indigo lightning-fur wolf matches the owner bar's Tanglevolt in every pose and holds its material grounded on the floor, whereas A's faint frames swap to a white body with black blotches and its hit react is indistinguishable from standing.

Df.bar_b_note: The armoured boar has strong bulk and scale against the trainer, but the faint frames collapse into a near-black smear, faint mid floats above a detached shadow, and A's glowing red seams push danger-red onto a friendly creature.

Fp.bar_b_note: B's warm olive back with visible markings reads well, but the uniform tiled hex surface stays below the naturalistic plate and skin detail of the owner bar; A's sooty grey-black back sinks it further.

Ap.bar_b_note: B keeps the warm olive-umber body through faint end and swimming and the silhouette reads, but the evenly tiled hex pattern looks procedural rather than Palworld-finished; A reads sooty grey-black in every frame.

Hd.bar_b_note: The white-haired elder's readable face and eyes, green scarf and olive-brown vest fit the Meadows palette and a cozy stylised NPC finish, held back only by a stiff, small full-body stance.

top_changes.change: Lock the amphibian creature's body material to the warm olive-umber albedo with visible markings in every state (standing, faint end, swim), and replace the uniform tiled hex pattern with an authored scale/plate texture that varies in size over back, flank and belly

Fix faint-state material and grounding: no material swap on faint (Fa side A turns white with black blotches), no near-black smear on Df faint, and drop fainted bodies onto the stage so they touch their shadows (Df faint mid floats)
Ship the braced timber homestead wall with cap and stone plinth (Et side A) and give its infill a textured daub or plank surface with depth instead of flat cream
